You want to contribute to LifeOS AI? Follow this process.

1. Find an existing issue<br>
   ↓<br>
2. Comment that you want to work on it<br>
   ↓<br>
3. Fork repository<br>
   ↓<br>
4. Create branch<br>
   ↓<br>
5. Implement changes<br>
   ↓<br>
6. Run tests<br>
   ↓<br>
7. Push branch<br>
   ↓<br>
8. Open Pull Request<br>
   ↓<br>
9. Maintainer reviews<br>
   ↓<br>
10. Changes requested / approved<br>
   ↓<br>
11. CI passes<br>
   ↓<br>
12. Merge
